headline: Large net loss; occupancy edges up slightly

kpis.label: FFO per share, diluted, as adjusted

drivers.explanation: Net increase primarily from lease commencements during the quarter; occupancy including signed future leases was 90.8%.

summary_short: Alexandria reported a Q3 net loss of $3.74 per diluted share, while FFO per share as adjusted was $1.54 and occupancy of operating properties rose to 87.1%.
summary_long: Revenue of $671.2M was up slightly from the prior quarter but below $751.9M a year ago. Occupancy of operating properties was 87.1% (86.9% at June 30), or 90.8% including executed leases not yet occupied. Management stays on track for 4Q26 annualized leverage guidance of 5.6x-6.2x with $4.6B of liquidity, and expects 2027 same-property NOI to improve versus 2026 but remain negative. A $1.0B junior subordinated note issuance closed in August.
confidence_notes: The cause of the quarter's large GAAP net loss was not isolated in the sections read (targeted extraction of a very large supplement). FFO as adjusted is a company-defined non-GAAP measure.
